# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength without vigilance leads to ambush. Courage without firm footing leads to collapse. God isn't calling you to a passive faith where you simply show up and hope for the best. He's calling you to a vigilant, grounded, deliberate manhood.

Every morning you wake up, a battle is already underway. Your flesh, the world, and the enemy all have a vote on how your day goes. But you get the final say. You decide whether you'll open your Bible or open your phone. Whether you'll pray or procrastinate. Whether you'll lead your family or drift through the day on autopilot.

Strength isn't born in the moment of crisis—it's built in the quiet disciplines of ordinary days. The man who stands firm on Sunday is the man who stood firm on Tuesday. Be watchful today. Stand firm today. Act like a man today. The battle is real, but so is your God.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, declare one area where you will stand firm today. Then spend 5 minutes in prayer before you touch your phone.
